steps.en: Install the client package; the whole engine ships inside it
steps.zh: 装客户端包，整个引擎就在包里

steps.en: Point SQL straight at your files or DataFrames — no load step
steps.zh: SQL 直接指向文件或 DataFrame，不用先导入

steps.en: Runs the query inside your process: reads only the needed columns, in parallel on all cores
steps.zh: 在你的进程里执行：只读需要的列，多核并行

steps.en: Open a database file when results should outlive the script
steps.zh: 结果要留到脚本之后，就打开一个库文件

steps.en: Stores tables in that one file, which any DuckDB client can reopen later
steps.zh: 表存进这一个文件，之后任何 DuckDB 客户端都能再打开

value.en: Warehouse-style SQL over local and remote files from a script, notebook or CLI — no server, no import job
value.zh: 在脚本、notebook 或命令行里对本地和远程文件跑数仓式 SQL，不用起服务、不用写导入任务

sources: https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-web docs/current/clients/python/overview.md (pip install duckdb; duckdb.sql("SELECT * FROM 'example.parquet'"); duckdb.connect("file.db") persists and can be reopened from other DuckDB clients; querying pandas/Polars DataFrames)
